test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair of letter-clusters which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two sets of pair of letter-clusters given below. Both pairs of letter-clusters follow the same pattern.

BFG : LPQ

HKM : RUW
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/976a92671b562a474c13b7b61f4327b9eba6e2946864cc3bcaee8d8ca9ecf9db.png] ​

**Logic: '10' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.**

**Given:**

**BFG : LPQ →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e69df54d4f8a472f7534d29f6d10a24605695da0857281aa32e3e5164e9b095e.png] 

**HKM : RUW →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a87e9dff348ff3a21450eb1abd6107f8f7cdf2966758e0cf24cd8a07cc0e69c2.png] 

Checking the given options:

**1. **MPO : WZY →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc14e867f8c6d85aa955f0c8394dc894d86343ac194ea6348c4d04d949ed8def.png] 

**2. **GKN : TPM →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64852956f61dc2ffeada757eb464e088299b74dcce1ef2201695e074b5b2c3b9.png] 

**3. **ABC : FGH →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3442c2c39a689eb2884f9466d84062a88381d6de0255158c684f1d981f0d055f.png] 

**4. **JRS : IQR →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ced1d04d3d31b654bd50859193f172bb8cd4b49e65aa8017bc2075ca459b062a.png] 

Here, **'****MPO : WZY' **is similar to the given sets of the alphabet.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
